headline: Child and adult killed in covered van crash in Madaripur
summary: Two members of the same family, including a child named Aisha, died after their easy bike was hit by a covered van in Shibchar.
details: Two people, including a child named Aisha, were killed after a covered van hit their easy bike in Shibchar, Madaripur.
The victims were members of the same family and were reportedly on their way to attend a wedding ceremony when the accident occurred.
At least four other people were injured in the crash and have been receiving medical treatment.
The incident has left the family in deep mourning as they lost two loved ones during a journey to a celebration.
caption:
A trip to a wedding ended in tragedy as a covered van crushed an easy bike in Madaripur.

Two people, including a child named Aisha, were killed after a covered van hit their easy bike in Shibchar, Madaripur.

The victims were members of the same family and were reportedly on their way to attend a wedding ceremony when the accident occurred.

At least four other people were injured in the crash and have been receiving medical treatment.

The incident has left the family in deep mourning as they lost two loved ones during a journey to a celebration.

#Madaripur #RoadAccident #Bangladesh #Tragedy #RoadSafety

Source: Prothom Alo, Somoy News

headline: 60 kmph winds: Parts of Bangladesh may see heavy rain in 24 hours
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) warns of a deepening low-pressure system that could bring heavy rainfall and strong winds across several regions.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has warned that parts of the country may experience heavy rainfall within the next 24 hours. This is due to a low-pressure system currently intensifying in the Bay of Bengal.
caption:
Heavy rain and 60 kmph winds are coming. Is your area on the list?

The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has warned that parts of the country may experience heavy rainfall within the next 24 hours. This is due to a low-pressure system currently intensifying in the Bay of Bengal.
